requirement_ref.quote: A shopper can filter the product list by category.

test_objective: Filtering by Electronics narrows the product list to electronics only.
preconditions: the catalogue contains products in more than one category

steps.actor_intent: arrive at the storefront as an anonymous shopper
narrow the catalogue to the Electronics category

outcomes.statement: Only products belonging to Electronics remain listed.
The Electronics category is shown as the one currently applied.

not_verifiable_yet: That the filtered set matches what the catalogue API returns for Electronics — comparing UI against backend needs an HTTP client the executor does not have.
